title: Input Pathways Shape Few-Shot, Not Zero-Shot, Binding in Tiny Transformers: A Fully-Enumerable Study
abstract: arXiv:2607.04926v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How does the way information reaches a transformer -- as symbolic tokens, a clean per-factor "oracle" code, or an entangled perceptual vector -- shape whether it binds that information compositionally? We study ~6-10K-parameter transformers on finite factored worlds enumerated exhaustively, so every measurement covers the whole input space and the informative routes are information-matched (exact Bayes ceiling 1.0). Four findings. (1) Endpoint invariance: on held-out binding queries no informative route reaches converged zero-shot composition -- each ends at or below chance, so the failure reflects inductive bias under a lookup-sufficient objective, not missing information. It also holds with the state in its own sequence position rather than added to every token. translated_title: 输入通路塑造微型Transformer的小样本绑定而非零样本绑定：一项完全可枚举的研究
translated_abstract: 信息以何种方式到达Transformer——是以符号token的形式、清晰的逐因子“神谕”代码，还是纠缠的感知向量——会如何影响它能否对这些信息进行组合式绑定？我们在有限因子世界上研究了约6-10K参数的微型Transformer，并对整个输入空间进行穷举枚举，因此每次测量都覆盖全部输入空间，且各信息通路在信息量上是精确匹配的（贝叶斯准确上限为1.0）。研究得出四个发现：(1) 终点不变性：在留出的绑定查询上，没有任何一条信息通路能够达到收敛的零样本组合能力——每条通路都终止于随机水平或以下，因此这种失败反映的是在查表即可充分完成目标情况下的归纳偏置问题，而非信息缺失。即使将状态放在其自身的序列位置、而不是加到每个token上，该结论依然成立。(2) 可读性决定小样本绑定：当留出类型的一小部分数据泄漏进训练集时，样本效率与代码可读性成正比。可读性最差的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对微型Transformer进行完全可枚举实验发现，无论信息以符号token、神谕代码还是纠缠感知向量的形式输入，模型都无法实现零样本组合绑定（其失败源于归纳偏置而非信息缺失），但在小样本设置下，绑定学习的样本效率由输入代码的可读性决定。
en_tdlr: Through fully-enumerable experiments on tiny transformers, this study shows that no input pathway—symbolic tokens, oracle codes, or entangled perceptual vectors—achieves converged zero-shot compositional binding due to inductive bias rather than missing information, while in few-shot settings, binding sample efficiency is governed by the readability of the input code.
